user.title: IPTV proxy
user.description: Xtream Codes login. It stays on this Home Assistant; the dashboard only uses signed proxy URLs.

find_channels.name: Find channels
find_channels.description: Search the provider's live channels by name and return their stream ids, for use in the TV Channels Card.

query.name: Search
query.description: Words that must all appear in the channel name or category, e.g. 'de zdf'.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return.

inspect_vod.name: Inspect film or episode
inspect_vod.description: Shows what a film or episode really contains: the provider's details, whether an HLS version exists and, when ffprobe is available, its video, audio and subtitle tracks. Useful to see which subtitles can be shown.

id.name: Id
id.description: Stream id of the film, or episode id of the episode.

extension.name: Extension
extension.description: File extension (mkv, mp4, ...). Optional for films; for episodes use the extension from the series info.

find_vod.name: Find films and series
find_vod.description: Search the provider's films and series by name and return their ids, for use with inspect_vod.

query.name: Search
query.description: Words that must all appear in the title or category.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of films and of series to return.
